# Background

We follow the same methodology as in [Chazot et at 2021](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-021-25906-8#Sec10) to prepare a tree for Danaini.

We base our analyses on 12 gene regions for all Danaini available in NCBI, the mitochondrial COI gene and the nuclear genes ArgKin, CAD, DDC , EF1a, GAPDH, IDH, MDH, RpS5, RpS2, wingless, and ATPa. The sequences are aligned with MAFFT2, and we use IQTREE to find the best topology.

# 1 Danaini sampling

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(rentrez)
library(stringr)
library(ape)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(Biostrings)
```

Danaini species with available sequences in NCBI - February 2026 (don't rerun)

```{r}
options(timeout = 600)
ncbi_pause = function() Sys.sleep(0.34)

# 1) Get the NCBI taxid for Danaini (tribe)
get_danaini_taxid = function(){
  hit = rentrez::entrez_search(db = "taxonomy", term = "Danaini[Scientific Name]", retmax = 10)
  ncbi_pause()
  
  sums = rentrez::entrez_summary(db = "taxonomy", id = hit$ids)
  ncbi_pause()
  sums = if (inherits(sums, "esummary")) list(sums) else sums

  # pick the one that is explicitly rank = tribe (fallback = first hit)
  tribe = keep(sums, ~ tolower(.x$rank %||% "") == "tribe" && (.x$scientificname %||% "") == "Danaini")
  as.character((tribe[[1]]$uid %||% hit$ids[[1]]))
}

# helper from pipeline
`%||%` = function(x, y) if (!is.null(x) && length(x) && !is.na(x)) x else y

# 2) Get all Danaini species names (binomials only)
get_danaini_species = function(retmax = 20000){

  danaini_id = get_danaini_taxid()

  # all descendants in taxonomy
  desc = rentrez::entrez_search(db = "taxonomy",
                                term = paste0("txid", danaini_id, "[Subtree]"),
                                retmax = retmax)
  ncbi_pause()

  ids = desc$ids
  if (length(ids) == 0) stop("No descendants returned for Danaini subtree.")

  # download taxonomy summaries in batches, then keep only rank == species
  batches = split(ids, ceiling(seq_along(ids)/500))

  sums =
    map(batches, function(b){
      out = rentrez::entrez_summary(db = "taxonomy", id = b)
      ncbi_pause()
      if (inherits(out, "esummary")) out = list(out)
      out
    }) %>%
    unlist(recursive = FALSE)

  tibble(
    butterfly_species = map_chr(sums, ~ .x$scientificname %||% NA_character_),
    rank             = map_chr(sums, ~ tolower(.x$rank %||% ""))
  ) %>%
    filter(rank == "species") %>%
    transmute(butterfly_species) %>%
    filter(str_detect(butterfly_species, "^[A-Z][a-z]+\\s+[a-z]+$")) %>%  # Genus species
    distinct(butterfly_species) %>%
    arrange(butterfly_species)
}

# === RUN ===
species = get_danaini_species(retmax = 20000)
nrow(species)

write_csv(species,"danaini_species_taxonomy.csv")

species = read_csv("./danaini_species_taxonomy.csv")
nrow(species)
```

# 2 Gene sampling

## 2.1 Define gene

```{r}
loci = tribble(
  ~locus,   ~term_fragment,              ~min_len, ~max_len, ~keep_n,
  "COI",    'mitochondrion[filter] AND (COI[Gene] OR cox1[Gene] OR "cytochrome c oxidase subunit I"[Title] OR COX1[All Fields] OR CO1[All Fields])',  500,   30000,      3,
  "ArgKin", '(ArgKin[Gene] OR "arginine kinase"[Title] OR ArgK[All Fields])',                                                          200,   30000,      3,
  "CAD",    '(CAD[Gene] OR "carbamoylphosphate synthetase"[Title] OR rudimentary[Title] OR CAD[All Fields])',                          200,   30000,      3,
  "DDC",    '(DDC[Gene] OR "dopa decarboxylase"[Title] OR DDC[All Fields])',                                                           200,   30000,      3,
  "EF1a",   '(EF1a[Gene] OR "elongation factor-1 alpha"[Title] OR "elongation factor 1 alpha"[Title] OR EF-1alpha[All Fields])',      200,   30000,      3,
  "GAPDH",  '(GAPDH[Gene] OR "glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase"[Title] OR GAPDH[All Fields])',                                 200,   30000,      3,
  "IDH",    '(IDH[Gene] OR "isocitrate dehydrogenase"[Title] OR IDH[All Fields])',                                                     200,   30000,      3,
  "MDH",    '(MDH[Gene] OR "malate dehydrogenase"[Title] OR MDH[All Fields])',                                                         200,   30000,      3,
  "RpS5",   '(Rps5[Gene] OR RpS5[All Fields] OR "ribosomal protein S5"[Title])',                                                       150,   30000,      3,
  "RpS2",   '(Rps2[Gene] OR RpS2[All Fields] OR "ribosomal protein S2"[Title])',                                                       150,   30000,      3,
  "wg",     '(wingless[Gene] OR wingless[Title] OR wg[All Fields])',                                                                    200,   30000,      3,
  "Atpa",
'((("Na+/K+"[Title] OR "Na+,K+"[Title] OR "Na K"[Title]) AND ATPase[Title] AND alpha[Title]) OR
  ((sodium[Title] AND potassium[Title]) AND ATPase[Title] AND alpha[Title]) OR
  atpa[Gene])',
150, 30000, 3
)
```

## 2.4 Occupancy matrix

```{r}
locus_names = loci$locus

occupancy_long =
  map_dfr(locus_names, function(lc){

    # locate accession summary flies for danaini and outgroups
    f_dan = file.path("ncbi_loci",      lc, paste0(lc, "_accessions_trimmed.csv"))
    f_out = file.path("ncbi_outgroups", lc, paste0(lc, "_accessions_trimmed.csv"))

    # read Danaini data
    dan =
      if (file.exists(f_dan)) {
        read_csv(f_dan, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
          transmute(butterfly_species, locus = lc, present = as.integer(n_ids > 0))
      } else NULL

    # read outgroup data
    out =
      if (file.exists(f_out)) {
        read_csv(f_out, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
          transmute(butterfly_species, locus = lc, present = as.integer(n_ids > 0))
      } else NULL

    bind_rows(dan, out)
  }) %>%
  # remove duplicates
  distinct(butterfly_species, locus, .keep_all = TRUE)

occupancy_matrix = occupancy_long %>% 
  #convert to wide
  pivot_wider(names_from  = locus, values_from = present, values_fill = 0)



# rowSums(occupancy_matrix[,-1]) |> summary() # what is the media loci per species?
```

# 3 Alignment per gene

Each gene is aligned separately. For nuclear genes, treat them as CDS. Translate each nucleotide sequence to amino acids, align at the protein level (this preserves reading frame and avoids false indels), then back-translate the aligned amino acids to nucleotides. For COI, do codon-aware alignment, but using the invertebrate mitochondrial genetic code instead of the nuclear one.

-   After alignment, clean each locus (trim ragged ends, pick one sequence per species).
-   Inspect alignment in Galaxy, <https://usegalaxy.eu>)
-   Iterate alignment after removing bad accessions

## 3.1 Primary alignment per gene

```{r}
source("codon_align_locus.R")
```

Run mafft alignment per locus

```{r}
# nuclear genes
codon_align_locus("ArgKin")
codon_align_locus("CAD")
codon_align_locus("DDC")
codon_align_locus("EF1a")
codon_align_locus("GAPDH")
```

# 4 Trim alignment per gene

Here we (1) trim alignment, (2) keep best accession/species/gene, and (3) standardize taxa names across genes.

```{r}
source("./trim_locus_alignment.R")
```

```{r}
ArgKin = readDNAStringSet("ncbi_alignments_filtered/ArgKin/ArgKin_filtered_codon_aln.fasta")
length(ArgKin)          # number of taxa
width(ArgKin)[1]        # alignment length (all rows)

trim_codon_alignment(
  in_fasta  = "ncbi_alignments_filtered/ArgKin/ArgKin_filtered_codon_aln.fasta",
  out_fasta = "trimmed/ArgKin.final.fasta",
  start = 1,      # must satisfy (start - 1) %% 3 == 0
  end   = 306,    # must satisfy (end - start + 1) %% 3 == 0
  max_bad = 0.20,
  one_per_species = TRUE,
  standardize_names = TRUE,
  fail_on_unknown = TRUE
)
```

# 6 Concatanate genes

**Build the supermatrix + partitions:** concatenate loci into one alignment, and write a partition file (at minimum: one partition per locus; better: codon1/2/3 for nuclear + COI separately).

```{r}
library(Biostrings)
library(purrr)

# 1) list all trimmed locus alignments
files = list.files("trimmed", pattern = "\\.final\\.fasta$", full.names = TRUE)

# (keep all genes)  <-- remove any filtering like this:
# files = files[!grepl("MDH", files)]

# 2) read alignments into a named list
loci = map(files, readDNAStringSet)

# name loci by locus (strip ".final.fasta")
names(loci) = sub("\\.final$", "", tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(files)))

# 3) get union of taxa across loci
all_taxa = unique(unlist(map(loci, names)))
length(all_taxa)

# 4) build concatenated sequences (supermatrix) + partition coordinates
superseq = setNames(vector("list", length(all_taxa)), all_taxa)
current_pos = 1
partitions = data.frame()

for (locus_name in names(loci)) {

  aln = loci[[locus_name]]
  w = unique(width(aln))                 # alignment length for this locus
  if (length(w) != 1) stop("Alignment width inconsistent in ", locus_name)

  # for each taxon: real sequence if present, else all gaps of length w
  block = sapply(all_taxa, function(tx){
    if (tx %in% names(aln)) as.character(aln[[tx]]) else paste(rep("-", w), collapse = "")
  })

  # append locus block to growing concatenation
  if (current_pos == 1) {
    superseq = as.list(block)
  } else {
    superseq = Map(paste0, superseq, block)
  }

  # record partition coordinates (1-based, inclusive)
  partitions = rbind(
    partitions,
    data.frame(locus = locus_name, start = current_pos, end = current_pos + w - 1)
  )

  current_pos = current_pos + w
}

# 5) write outputs
superDNA = DNAStringSet(unlist(superseq))
names(superDNA) = names(superseq)

writeXStringSet(superDNA, "supermatrix.fasta")
write.csv(partitions, "partitions.csv", row.names = FALSE)

length(superDNA)         # number of taxa
unique(width(superDNA))  # total alignment length

# 6) quick gap fraction summary per taxon
gap_frac = function(s){
  x = strsplit(as.character(s), "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  mean(x == "-")
}
summary(vapply(superDNA, gap_frac, numeric(1)))
```

-   76 taxa in the concatenated matrix, total length 6585 bp

-   Gap fractions: median \~0.71 (so many loci are missing per taxon) — not a problem for IQ-TREE, given COI scaffold.

# 7 Infer tree

**Infer the tree in IQ-TREE:** run partitioned ML (ModelFinder on partitions, bootstrap), then inspect support; if a backbone node is weak, look at single-locus gene trees or occupancy to diagnose missing data vs conflict.

```{r}
# Writes the partition file for IQ-TREE that splits each locus into 3 codon-position partitions

part = read.csv("partitions.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# make sure the matrix length matches
stopifnot(max(part$end) == 6585)

# helper to create codon-position ranges within a locus block
codon_ranges = function(start, end, pos){  # pos = 1,2,3
  # positions in the supermatrix for this codon position
  seq(from = start + (pos - 1), to = end, by = 3)
}

# write an IQ-TREE partition file in "nexus-like" format
# (IQ-TREE accepts this for -p)
write_iqtree_codon_partitions = function(part, outfile = "partitions_codon.nex"){
  con = file(outfile, open = "wt")
  on.exit(close(con))

  writeLines("#nexus", con)
  writeLines("begin sets;", con)

  for(i in seq_len(nrow(part))){
    locus = part$locus[i]
    s = part$start[i]
    e = part$end[i]

    # sanity: each locus block should be divisible by 3
    if(((e - s + 1) %% 3) != 0){
      stop("Locus block not divisible by 3: ", locus, " (", s, "-", e, ")")
    }

    for(pos in 1:3){
      p_name = paste0(locus, "_pos", pos)
      # IQ-TREE range shorthand: start-end\3 with offset handled by start+(pos-1)
      p_start = s + (pos - 1)
      line = paste0("  charset ", p_name, " = ", p_start, "-", e, "\\3;")
      writeLines(line, con)
    }
  }

  writeLines("end;", con)
  message("Wrote: ", outfile)
}

write_iqtree_codon_partitions(part, "partitions_codon.nex")
```

Bash command:

iqtree2 -s supermatrix.fasta -p partitions_codon.nex -m MFP+MERGE -B 1000 --bnni -T AUTO -pre Danaini_concat

# 9 Accessionσ for tree

```{r}

# pull accession out of a FASTA header (e.g. XM_032672544.2, EU141321.1, etc.)
get_acc = function(h) stringr::str_extract(h, "[A-Z]{1,3}_?\\d{5,}(?:\\.\\d+)?")

# given an ungapped final sequence, return index of best-matching candidate (or NA)
best_hit = function(seq_ungap, cand){
  pat = DNAString(seq_ungap)
  hit = pmax(
    vcountPattern(pat, cand, fixed = TRUE),
    vcountPattern(reverseComplement(pat), cand, fixed = TRUE)
  )
  if (max(hit) == 0) return(NA_integer_)
  which.max(hit)
}

# recover accessions for one locus
recover_one_locus = function(locus){
  final_fa = file.path("trimmed", paste0(locus, ".final.fasta"))
  cand1    = file.path("ncbi_loci", locus, paste0(locus, "_all_trimmed_plus_outgroups.fasta"))
  cand2    = file.path("ncbi_loci", locus, paste0(locus, "_all_trimmed.fasta"))
  cand_fa  = if (file.exists(cand1)) cand1 else cand2

  if (!file.exists(final_fa) || !file.exists(cand_fa)) {
    warning("Missing fasta for locus: ", locus)
    return(tibble(locus = locus, butterfly_species = character(), accession = character()))
  }

  final = readDNAStringSet(final_fa)
  cand  = readDNAStringSet(cand_fa)

  idx = vapply(gsub("-", "", as.character(final), fixed = TRUE),
               best_hit, integer(1), cand = cand)

  tibble(
    locus = locus,
    butterfly_species = names(final),
    accession = ifelse(is.na(idx), NA_character_, get_acc(names(cand)[idx]))
  )
}

# --- run across all loci present in trimmed/ ---
loci = sub("\\.final\\.fasta$", "", list.files("trimmed", pattern = "\\.final\\.fasta$"))

all_long = map_dfr(loci, recover_one_locus)

all_wide = all_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = locus, values_from = accession)

write_csv(all_wide, "Supplementary_Data_1.csv")
```
